title: The gate `pnpm run check` is not hermetic: it collects tests and Markdown from `.claude/worktrees/` and transient `.git` lease reflogs, so its result depends on other sessions
source: package.json:23 (docs:check glob `'**/*.md' '#node_modules'`); no vitest.config.*; src/docs-check.ts:19-28 (walk skips only .git and node_modules)
evidence: Run 1 of `pnpm run check` (2026-10-11): 6 failures from .claude/worktrees/handoff (consistency.test.ts:83 'FAC-SEM-053..055 not allocated', schema-compilation.test.ts:8 'expected 66 got 67'). Run 2: `Test Files 1 failed | 67 passed (68)`, `Tests 4 failed | 2154 passed (2158)`, all from .claude/worktrees/dec41/test/meter-grant.test.ts. markdownlint: `Linting: 2698 file(s) Summary: 20614 error(s)` (worktree node_modules LICENSE.md files, and `.git/logs/refs/remotes/agent-sync-leases/docs%2FDECISIONS.md:1:115 MD010`). Main tree alone: `npx vitest run --dir test` gives `Test Files 22 passed (22) Tests 698 passed (698)`; `npx markdownlint-cli2 '**/*.md' '#node_modules' '#.claude'` gives `Linting: 78 file(s) Summary: 0 error(s)`. The .git lease reflogs had disappeared by a later run (`ls .git/logs/refs/remotes/agent-sync-leases/`: No such file), so the failure is intermittent. CI on main 8e49fbd: success (gh run list).
status_measured: open: the local gate is red on the operator's checkout whenever a worktree exists under .claude/worktrees/ (git status shows `?? .claude/worktrees/`) or a lease reflog is present. CI is green.
proposed_fix: Add vitest.config.ts with `test.include: ['test/**/*.test.ts']` (or exclude `.claude/**`). Change docs:check to lint tracked docs only (e.g. ignores `.claude/**`, `.git/**`, `**/node_modules/**` in .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc). Make docs-check.ts walk() skip `.claude`. Add `.claude/worktrees/` to .gitignore.

title: DEC-0011's claim/proof contract has no rule: a `done` claim without proof need not appear in `notVerified`, `proof.claimIds` may name claims that do not exist, and FAC-SEM-001's text does not match its code
evidence: Spec: 'A claim with no independent proof MAY be reported as done ... but it MUST also be present in `notVerified`'. Probe via tsx: e('result',{outcome:'succeeded',done:[{claimId:'X1'}],proof:[],notVerified:[]}) -> []; e('result',{...proof:[{claimIds:['NOPE']}]}) -> []. FAC-SEM-001's register text is 'a succeeded result keeps no unverified required claim', but the code fires on ANY notVerified item (`value.notVerified.length > 0`). result.schema.json notVerified items carry no 'required' marker.
status_measured: open: the core DEC-0011 invariant is unchecked.
proposed_fix: Reserve a FAC-SEM code (`agent_sync.py reserve SEM`) for result integrity: every proof.claimIds member names a done.claimId, and every done claim with no proof item appears in notVerified by claim id. Add tests and fixtures. Reword FAC-SEM-001's register row to what the code checks (any notVerified item), or add a required flag. The flag is a schema change.

title: DEC-0012 and DEC-0004 approval separation is unchecked: a learning proposal may target a checker and be approved by its own author, and FAC-SEM-003 only repeats a schema const
evidence: DEC-0012: 'cannot target an active revision or its own checker' and 'requires the scope owner'. Schema: target enum includes 'checker'; approvedBy is any URI; selfApply is `const: false` (required), so FAC-SEM-003 (`value.selfApply !== false`) can only fire on a schema-invalid document. Probe: e('learning',{selfApply:false,target:'checker',state:'approved',approvedBy:'urn:a',meta:{createdBy:'urn:a'}}) -> []. Promotion: approvedBy is not checked against the CEO or against meta.createdBy (governance-and-roles.md:62 'An agent MUST NOT approve its own global promotion').
status_measured: open
proposed_fix: Add a rule (new SEM code) over learning and promotion bundles: approvedBy != meta.createdBy; for a learning proposal, basisRevision is not the active revision passed in the bundle, and target 'checker' does not name the checker of the retro's own run. Test each.

title: FAC-SEM-006 cannot detect a project with no product manager, and has no test
evidence: The project set is built only from active product-manager assignments, so a project with zero PMs is never examined. Probe: roles with a CEO, a developer on urn:p:b and a PM on urn:p:a -> []. `grep -rl FAC-SEM-006 test` gives 0 files (every other code 000-052 has at least one test file). DEC-0006: 'exactly one product manager owns each project's backlog'.
status_measured: open
proposed_fix: Derive projects from every project-scoped assignment (any role) and require exactly one active PM for each. Add positive and negative cases to test/semantic-rules.test.ts. A project with no assignment at all needs a project list in roles.schema.json, which is a schema decision.

evidence: Line 122: '`result` is the **result envelope**: `{done, proof, scope, notVerified, output, usage}` (DEC-0011 collections plus usage)'. Line 145: 'Ruled (DEC-0017, OQ-0002). A job's result is the full result envelope ... One shape, no subset.' schemas/interop-result.schema.json is allOf[result.schema.json, required output+usage], which requires id, contractVersion, outcome, artifacts, createdAt and producer.

title: DEC-0022's idempotency digest uses an under-specified 'canonical JSON', with no reference function, fixture or test vector; the contract already has two other canonical forms
evidence: Comms: 'Canonical JSON uses sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, integers only'. It does not say whether keys sort by code point or UTF-16 unit; these differ above U+FFFF. Settings backup (service.md:430-435) uses ', ' and ': ' separators and code-point order. Delegation uses RFC 8785 (sources.md:36). `grep -rn "NUL\|commsDigest" src test fixtures` finds nothing. The Fabric checkout (659ff356) has only docs, no digest code, so no implementation would break.
status_measured: open: two conforming boards/clients may compute different digests and answer idempotency_conflict
proposed_fix: State the order as RFC 8785 member order restricted to integers (or code-point order) and name it once. Add src/comms-digest.ts with a known-answer test vector including a non-BMP key.
